acquisition method: A data-dependent procedure that alternated between one MS scan was used, followed by 20 MS/MS scans.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 15 min at room temperature under dark conditions.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 15 min at room temperature under dark conditions.
cleavage agent: the sample was digested with trypsin (Promega) overnight
fractionation method: Peptides were fractionated by high pH reverse-phase HPLC with an Agilent 300 Extend C18 column
instrument: tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q Exactive PlusTM (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to the UPLC.
ionization type: The peptides results were subjected to nano electrospray ionization (NSI) source
labeling: TMT 10-plex was selected for protein quantification.
mass analyzer: Peptides were then selected for MS/MS in the orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.
precursor tolerance: 10 ppm in First search and 5 ppm in Main search
The mass tolerance for precursor ions was set as to 10 ppm in First search and 5 ppm in Main search
fragment tolerance: the mass tolerance was set as 0.02 Da for fragment ions.
reduction reagent: the protein solution was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 30 min at 56°C
reduction concentration: the protein solution was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 30 min at 56°C
